package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for nullable_sql_types_leak_into_api_dto: Response or request DTOs that expose `sql.Null*` types instead of boundary-friendly contract types.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type ProfileResponse struct {
	ID        int            `json:"id"`
	Bio       sql.NullString `json:"bio"`
	Age       sql.NullInt64  `json:"age"`
	LastLogin sql.NullTime   `json:"last_login"`
}

func GetProfileHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp := ProfileResponse{
		ID:        1,
		Bio:       sql.NullString{String: "Hello world", Valid: true},
		Age:       sql.NullInt64{Int64: 30, Valid: true},
		LastLogin: sql.NullTime{Time: time.Now(), Valid: false},
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
